sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression measured by HiBiT luciferase complementation: CXCR3A-HiBiT extracellular luciferase activity confirmed robust plasma membrane display. Ligand-binding or signaling function NOT MEASURED in this assay.
sites.rationale: CXCR3 has no endogenous signal peptide; the canonical sequence begins at M1, which is extracellular (topology landmarks: residues 1–53 extracellular, TM1 starts at 54). A tag prepended before M1 therefore sits on the extracellular face, 53 residues from the TM1 boundary — well clear of the >=3-residue constraint. Because no paper names a specific residue number for the junction, the position is topology_derived: with only one extracellular terminus on a GPCR lacking a signal peptide, insert_after_residue=0 is the unique solution. Three independent publications (L5/L6 PMC10183793, L1 PMC13089336, L3 PMC11953467) all report N-terminal tags on full-length membrane-anchored CXCR3, converging on this single junction. Full-length CXCR3 (isoform A) expressed in mammalian cells with HiBiT fused at the N-terminal; surface display quantified by extracellular luciferase complementation assay (LgBiT added to medium). CXCR3A-HiBiT showed robust surface signal (~6-fold above CXCR3B). Corroborated by L1 (PMC13089336: full-length CXCR3 with exogenous HA-SS + FLAG + TEV at N-terminus for structural/pharmacological studies) and L3 (PMC11953467: full-length CXCR3 with N-terminal FLAG tag in pcDNA3.1 for functional GPCR signaling studies).

sources.claim: We investigated the membrane expression of the proteins by conducting HiBiT assays in cells expressing the receptors tagged with HiBiT at the N-terminal.

literature_notes: L1 (PMC13089336) reports a full-length CXCR3 construct with an exogenous HA signal sequence + FLAG + TEV at the N-terminus, used for structural and pharmacological studies; the HA-SS drives the FLAG to the extracellular face and the TEV site allows post-trafficking tag removal. L3 (PMC11953467) reports N-terminal FLAG on full-length CXCR3 for GPCR functional studies. Both corroborate the same N-terminal prepend junction as L5/L6 and are noted in the rationale but L5 is chosen as the primary supporting clip because it provides the most explicit surface-expression measurement (extracellular HiBiT luciferase). L6 (PMC10183793) adds that CXCR3A-HiBiT surface signal is ~6-fold above CXCR3B, confirming the tag does not prevent trafficking of the canonical isoform. L7 (PMC10183793) reports that HiBiT-CXCR3Alt is not efficiently surface-expressed; this is an isoform-specific failure, not a failure of the junction per se, and is captured in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion (ECL1, ECL2, ECL3) for CXCR3, so no internal sites are proposed. The C-terminus (residue 368) is intracellular (topology: 322–368 intracellular) and is captured in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length CXCR3 C-terminus engineered with 3C protease + GFP + 2xStrep tag (PMC13089336); the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (topology: 322–368 intracellular), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
C-terminal HA- or FLAG-tagged CXCR3 variants used to investigate receptor expression (PMC10183793); C-terminus is intracellular.
C-terminal SmBiT fusion on full-length CXCR3 in pCAGGS (PMC11953467); C-terminus is intracellular.
